answer: New identities start on the lowest terrace with tiny voting weight, and reputation accrues only through verified work over epochs. Sybil resistance can work like a layered landscape: each agent must stake a bond that unlocks slowly, like meltwater from a glacier feeding a terrace of trust. Faking thousands of agents means locking real capital across a shifting dune of delayed withdrawals, and any proven sybil forfeits the entire bond. Attacker cost scales with identity count, making mass fakery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0020 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
